messages.subject: Bootstrapping Density CIs
parts:
Hello all,

Is there a direct way of bootstrapping mean densities and confidence intervals in the R packages Distance or mrds similar to what's done in Program Distance?

Many thanks and apologies if I missed a previous post.

Ian Ausprey

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Bootstrapping Density CIs
parts:
Hi Ian

I believe the short answer to your question is 'no'; you'd need to manufacture your own bootstrapping procedure in R and refit models to your resamples.
